cds.title: University of Kansas Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF, sections A-J)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set, applicants by residency: 7,479 in-state, 14,011 out-of-state and 697 international. The international admit rate is calculated as 657/697 = 94.3%, with 157 enrolled. Undergraduate enrollment is 22,544 (all undergraduates), of whom 690 are international (nonresident aliens). No early decision or early action; no waitlist. Admission is formula-style: students are assured admission with a 3.25+ GPA, or ACT 21 / SAT 1060 with a 2.0+ GPA (per the Common Data Set); international applicants are admitted at a 2.5 GPA per the international admissions page.

cds_test_policy.notes: From the Common Data Set: SAT/ACT not required for admission but considered; KU highly encourages scores, which do not hurt admission eligibility but may be used by professional schools and for placement.

cost.notes: From the Common Data Set (2025-26): out-of-state tuition is also paid by international students. Aid (final AY2025): only the college's own non-need-based aid (International Admissions Scholarships); 330 international undergraduates received aid, averaging $12,572 ($4,148,695 total). The international admissions cost page (year not printed) estimates $33,854 tuition and fees plus $18,424 living expenses = $52,278 per year. Course fees vary by school
